licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score (quì, si bene, perchè, finchè; Giovanino with one n, chiacchere, ubbriacchi and Tutto 'quel with a stray apostrophe, as printed; come m'ordinaste where the libretto has come voi m'ordinaste; chiusa la porta a chiave a mi sottrai where the libretto has io mi cavai). The IPA follows the words as sung (Giovannino, chiacchiere).

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), pages 97–99, the recitative between No. 10b and No. 11 (45 bars)
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung lines and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out. Secco recitative: the piano part is the printed chords; no performance marks are printed. Bar 12 (chiacchere) keeps the Italian rhythm where the print also gives one for the English words. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 116 (about 1:33), from the median length of five complete recordings (Fricsay 1958 1:30, Giulini 1959 1:21, Böhm 1977 1:35, Karajan 1985 1:42, Solti 1996 1:39; median 1:35), less 1.5 s of track silence, as sources/cosi/TEMPI.md does.
